## Objective

Deliver the approved full operational initialization contract for new projects, first existing-project preparation and selected upgrades, using compatible source-owned packages and the established setup transaction model.

User value: A successful Sys4AI setup leaves the supported system usable with useful project content and evidence of operation, while an incomplete setup identifies its exact blocker and safe recovery.

### Success outcomes

- All 44 original TRD outcomes and 132 acceptance criteria have current attributable evidence or a separately authorized disposition.
- Three representative setup journeys reach the full required feature baseline on the selected supported host, preserving existing project work and explicit choices.
- Shared source, Template and active depot initializer agree on the reviewed release; other registered products remain unchanged.
- Component status, CLI outcome, app Health and final handoff agree, with no static-only or historical result presented as full current operation.

## Scope

### In scope

- Shared owner corrections for memory corpus paths, app compatibility, collaboration integrity, Lessons selection and isolated reader coverage.
- Full default capability selection, preflight, runtime/content preparation, governed adoption, operational qualification, readiness and recovery within the existing initializer.
- Source-grounded governance, role availability, learning/memory, core and supported advanced ontology, Home/Explorer, native collaboration and bounded Curator session operation.
- Checked source-to-Template distribution, exact active-depot adoption, three isolated representative setup journeys, focused regression evidence and current operational documentation.

### Out of scope

- Implementation or native delegation during this plan-creation turn; creation or activation of a project Task.
- Automatic adoption into Mathematics, Aether Flow or another real product; their supplied reports are evidence only.
- Product/scientific implementation, fabricated research results, exhaustive domain modeling, copied depot lessons or production sample Tasks.
- Retired workbench, unattended AI/services/schedules/hooks, external notifications, idle wakeups and standing autonomous writes.
- Git initialization/commit/push, new remotes, GitHub Pages, deployment, purchases, credential collection, relicensing or bulk propagation.
- Rewriting existing Task/TRD/plan history or claiming cross-platform/performance qualification not exercised.

### Execution authority

Creating, tracking or approving this plan does not authorize implementation, installation, dependency/model provisioning, native execution, publication, deployment or any other separately governed action. Execute only after a separate current instruction identifies the exact ready plan and required project/owner authority is established.
